title: Hostel Facilities and Accommodation Fees for Boys & Girls
content: The college provides separate on-campus hostels for boys and girls with capacity for 800 students. Amenities include furnished twin-sharing and triple-sharing rooms, high-speed Wi-Fi internet, hygienic dining mess providing nutritious vegetarian food, 24/7 security with CCTV surveillance, solar water heaters, study rooms, and gym facilities.
